scripts.assets:cars: env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /usr/bin/blender --background --factory-startup --python blender/scripts/build_assets.py && node tools/sync-car-assets.mjs
scripts.assets:rewrite-cars: env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=/usr/bin:/bin ALSOFT_DRIVERS=null /usr/bin/blender --background --factory-startup -noaudio --python-exit-code 1 --python blender/scripts/build_rewrite_cars.py && node tools/sync-rewrite-cars.mjs
scripts.assets:rewrite: npm run assets:rewrite-cars && npm run assets:dining
